nodes.description: Private bool flag; once true every transfer burns a random amount and can mint a reward.
Address of the ETH-X20 Uniswap liquidity pool; only transfers whose sender equals this address can win the game.
Counter hashed into the pseudo-random value and incremented on every draw.
Owner-supplied seed used by _play for the win check.
Derived seed used to pick the random burn rate.
Set to 100 in startGame; never read afterwards - dead state variable.
Token balance mapping mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and reduced by _burn.
Owner address; the only account allowed to call startGame.
Mints 10000e18 tokens to msg.sender and leaves gameStarted false.
onlyOwner one-shot initialiser that sets liquidityPool, seed1/seed2 and flips gameStarted to true.
ERC20 transfer override that routes the amount through _getAmount before super.transfer.
ERC20 transferFrom override that routes the amount through _getAmount before super.transferFrom.
Public view returning the gameStarted flag.
Private hook that calls _sendReward and burns a random portion of the amount when the game is running.
Mints 10x the amount to the recipient when the sender is the liquidity pool and _play() returns true.
Computes the burnt amount as amount / (burnrate + 10) with burnrate taken from weak randomness.
Public game function returning true when two weak-random draws are equal (~1% chance).
Private RNG helper producing keccak256(nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty, msg.sender) % mod and bumping nonce.
Internal mint that increases total supply and the balance of an account.
Internal burn that decreases total supply and the balance of an account.
Internal balance-moving routine called by super.transfer / super.transferFrom.
Caller address; used as sender in transfer paths, as the onlyOwner check, and as an entropy source in _randModulus.
now, hashed into the RNG inside _randModulus so the draw is miner/validator influenceable.
_mint(recipient, amount.mul(10)) in _sendReward: a winning liquidity-pool transfer mints 10x the transferred amount out of thin air.
_burn(sender, burnAmount) in _getAmount: 1%-10% of each transfer is burned from the sender based on weak randomness.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty, msg.sender)) % mod - fully predictable, attacker and miner manipulable randomness driving mint and burn.
Liquidity pool address supplied by the owner to startGame.
First seed supplied by the owner to startGame.
Recipient of the ERC20 transfer.
Amount to transfer; feeds the burn/reward logic.
Debited account in transferFrom; compared against liquidityPool to allow a reward.
Credited account in transferFrom.
Amount moved in transferFrom.
Recipient forwarded into the reward path.
Sender forwarded into the reward path and compared with the liquidity pool.
Amount forwarded; basis for burn and reward computation.
Amount multiplied by 10 when the reward is minted.
Sender checked against liquidityPool to authorise the reward.
Account that receives the minted reward.
Amount divided by (burnrate + 10) to obtain the burn size.
Modulus bounding the random result.
Seed hashed together with nonce, now, block.difficulty and msg.sender.
Local holding the randomly computed burn, subtracted from the transfer amount.
Local burn rate in [0,90] returned by _randModulus(90, seed2).
First random draw from seed1 used in the win comparison.
Second random draw from seed2 used in the win comparison.
Local holding keccak256(...) % mod, the returned pseudo-random value.
